g.text: Simulated losses per minute, 45 trials of 30 s each (15 holes × 3 seeds). Bars = trials; curves = fitted normal; dot = mean ± 95 % CI
Source: data/raw/stand-bench-2026-10-05.csv (python3 -m tools.stand_bench). Simulation, not hardware.
A 30 s trial counts losses in steps of 2 per minute; 'after' piles up at 0, so its normal curve is only a guide.
